title: The Lavender Holiday Blowout Night
description: A lavender self-care and blowout night, all from Walmart: a gray and purple Nexpure ionic hair dryer, a lavender plush robe, lavender satin pillowcases, lavender fuzzy cross-band slippers, a heatable axolotl Warmies and essie expressie polish.
intro: December is a lot. Parties, shopping, wrapping, the school thing you forgot about. So one night a week deserves to be off duty: hair washed, a real blowout, a soft robe, fuzzy slippers, fresh polish and something warm on your lap. It takes about an hour and it makes the rest of the week feel doable. This look is built for that night, and it's all lavender.

sections.heading: The blowout
paragraphs: The Nexpure 2000W Ionic Hair Dryer in Purple: gray with purple trim, and it comes with a diffuser and a concentrator. The Satin Pillowcases Pair in Lavender (standard size, envelope closure) keep the blowout from turning into a frizz ball overnight.

sections.heading: The cozy part
paragraphs: The PAVILIA Fleece Plush Robe in Lavender Purple, long and soft. The Litfun Fuzzy Cross-Band Slippers in Lavender. The Axolotl Warmies, a 12-inch plush you can warm in the microwave, filled with millet and dried lavender. And essie expressie quick-dry polish in Throw It On, a soft pink.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The dresser, the mirror, the rug, the mug, the hair clips and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
